newsitem.title: HONG KONG: NWI to take stake in Jiangsu Expressway.
newsitem.headline: NWI to take stake in Jiangsu Expressway.

text.p: New World Infrastructure Ltd (NWI) is in discussion to buy about threee percent stake in Chinese toll road operator Jiangsu Expressway Co Ltd which is expected to seek a listing in mid-June, market sources said.
"New World Infrastructure is in discussion of taking a stake in the company (Jiangsu Expressway) but nothing has yet been finalised," a source close to New World Infrastructure said.
Market sources also said COSCO Pacific Ltd was also expected to take about three percent stake in Jiangsu Expressway. COSCO officials were not available for comment.
Sources close to underwriters said Jiangsu Expressway was expected to issue about 1.2 billion H-shares, or about 25 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, in a global offering in June.
Of the total, 90 percent is expected to be earmarked for international placement and 10 percent to be offered to the Hong Kong investors through a public offering, they said.
Jiangsu Expressway is expected to hold a presentation for analysts early in June before it kicks off its roadshow in the United States, Europe and Singapore later on, sources said.
The public offering in Hong Kong is expected to begin in mid-June with dealing in the company shares to begin a couple of days before the end of the month, they said.
HSBC Investment was expected to be the sponsor of the issue.

Last month, Jiangsu Expressway said it had applied to the Hong Kong bourse for an H-share listing in Hong Kong. It said earlier that it planned to raise about 4.0 billion yuan through seeking a listing in the first half of 1997.

Jiangsu Expressway, controlled by the Communications Department in Jiangsu province, owns and operates the Jiangsu section of Shanghai-Nanjing (Huning) Expressway connecting Shanghai and Nanjing. Total investment for the 247-km long Jiangsu section is about 6.2 billion yuan.
The company had said it would use the proceeds to repay loans, to buy an interest in Jiangsu National Highway and to participate in other highway development projects.
